text: The DAOIC pools no assets: the smart contract releases each member's deposit directly to the project after validation pool approval, and returns on purchases are likewise not pooled but paid pro rata to members in proportion to their reputation token holdings.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3949098

isBasedOn.name: Reputation as Capital – How DAOs Upgrade Finance

abstract: releases the deposit directly to the project. No pooling of assets takes place. The ROP from each deal is also not pooled but rather paid out pro rata to the DAOIC members in proportion to their RNFT holdings.
